args.thought: New branch gpu_mesh: implement the liquid pull edge as a single Skia Vertices/mesh strip (e.g., 16–24 segments) where x positions are fixed and y offsets are driven by pull distance + a damped spring. Keep the deformation on the UI thread using Reanimated shared values and push into Skia via useSharedValueEffect so JS stalls don’t affect the edge. Start with a simple quad strip + linear interpolation; optionally smooth y offsets with Catmull–Rom for a more ‘liquid’ contour while keeping vertex count low.
args.animationTechnique: Skia Vertices (mesh strip) + Reanimated shared values (UI thread) + useSharedValueEffect
args.performanceConsideration: Single draw call; avoid offscreen layers/groups that allocate intermediate textures. Keep segment count modest (<=24) and update only vertex positions to minimize CPU/GPU overhead.
args.visualEffect: A stable, iOS-like elastic liquid edge that stretches with pull and springs back smoothly, maintaining 60fps on Android.

args.thought: gpu_mesh follow-up: add a cheap highlight/shadow pass without extra layers—render the same mesh twice: (1) base fill; (2) a thin top stroke/path derived from the mesh’s top edge using a cached Path that only updates its control points. Clamp pull distance to prevent extreme curvature; apply non-linear easing (e.g., sqrt) to y offsets so small pulls feel responsive while large pulls don’t explode the mesh. Verify no per-frame allocations: reuse Float32Array for positions and avoid recreating Paint/Shader.
args.animationTechnique: Mesh fill + derived top-edge path; cached typed arrays for vertex positions
args.performanceConsideration: Reuse typed arrays and Path instances; avoid new arrays/objects per frame to reduce GC and keep frame pacing consistent.
args.visualEffect: Liquid edge has subtle lighting depth while remaining stable (no flicker) and performant during pulls and snap-back.

args.thought: Add an energy-efficient liquid-edge pull-to-refresh plan: drive the edge deformation entirely on the UI thread (Reanimated shared values + useSharedValueEffect into Skia values), and avoid <Group layer> / offscreen renders. Use a single Path (or two Paths for fill+stroke) with a small set of control points (e.g., quadratic/cubic) where only control-point Y offsets animate with a damped spring; keep arrays/points stable via useMemo + typed arrays to avoid GC. Clamp pull distance and throttle updates to prevent overdraw; prefer direct draw ops and reuse Paint/Shader instances. Validate on mid-range Android by checking GPU overdraw and frame time while JS is busy.
args.animationTechnique: Reanimated shared values -> Skia via useSharedValueEffect; spring-driven control points for a liquid edge Path
args.performanceConsideration: Keep animation on UI thread; avoid offscreen layers and shader/paint recreation; keep control-point arrays stable to reduce GC and overdraw on Android
args.visualEffect: A smooth, iOS-like stretchy liquid edge that follows the pull gesture and snaps back with a damped spring, staying stable at 60fps on Android with minimal battery impact

args.thought: Next step for the shimmer rewrite: prefer a single-pass Skia RuntimeEffect shader over multiple layered nodes to minimize draw calls and battery. Keep the RuntimeEffect instance stable (create once, memoize), and only update uniforms (e.g., u_time, u_resolution, u_intensity). Drive u_time on the UI thread (Reanimated shared value -> Skia value via useSharedValueEffect) to avoid JS-thread jank. Avoid per-frame allocations: memoize colors/stops arrays (use Float32Array for stops) and reuse a single uniforms object/array. Provide a low-cost noise option: hash-based value noise (no loops) to break banding; fall back to a static noise texture if RuntimeEffect cost is too high on mid-range Android. Validation checklist on target devices: profile GPU time and overdraw; cap FPS in dev to observe stability; ensure shader complexity is linear and no dynamic branching; confirm no extra offscreen layers are introduced. If battery is still high, reduce noise frequency and keep shimmer band width fixed to avoid high-frequency temporal changes.
args.animationTechnique: Skia RuntimeEffect shimmer driven by Reanimated shared value (UI thread) + stable memoized uniforms
args.performanceConsideration: Single-pass shader, memoize RuntimeEffect/uniforms, avoid per-frame allocations/GC, reduce shader complexity to protect battery on mid-range Android
args.visualEffect: A smooth shimmer band sweeping across a surface with subtle noise to prevent banding, stable 60fps with reduced battery impact on mid-range Android.
